source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of search algorithms (PDF 84).

blocks.text: Search algorithms dataset ke andar khaas elements, ya elements ka set, dhoondne ke liye banaye jate hain. Yeh maloomat nikalne (information retrieval), database queries aur decision-making (faisle karna) jaise kaamon ke liye bohat zaroori hain.

blocks.prompt: Search algorithms ke do rozmarra istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Phone mein contact dhoondna aur database mein record talash karna (ya search engine se page dhoondna).

items: Search algorithms data mein elements dhoondte hain: information retrieval, database queries, faisle.
